title: A Guide to Automated Packaging Systems
summary: A Guide to Automated Packaging Systems
body_markdown:
Smurfit Westrock's Automated Packaging Systems (APS) group designs and builds automatic packaging equipment, ranging from a single machine to a complete end-of-line system. Because our equipment specialists work closely with our packaging materials teams, we can tailor packaging designs to the machines that run them. That pairing of packaging and equipment helps manufacturers improve line efficiency, reduce manual labor and adapt as product, channel and production demands change.


The five video guides on this page give you a closer look at what APS can do. Start with "A Guide to Automated Packaging Equipment" for an overview of our[full end-of-line portfolio](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/products/packaging-machinery/end-of-line-packaging) , then watch the platform-specific guides to case forming, tray formers, case erectors and sealers, and robotic palletizers. Each video covers the operational challenges the equipment is built to solve, along with key capabilities such as speed, supported package styles and changeover flexibility.
